title: A Ledger for the Lantern
author: Hazel Joubert
blurb: Coral Ashgrove, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
